agent_notes.text: Self-hosting canopy.json created (TODO 5h). Agent-scored — all scores need human review. Relation graph covers CLI→schema, routes→canopy.ts, and docs→docs links. Run `canopytag health` to see what needs attention.
Current public docs are README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/cli-cheatsheet.md, and docs/roadmap.md. Compare/MCP/docs are now wired; use canopytag compare when deciding trust order between exact files.

src/shared/types.ts.title: Canopy Schema & Authority Health
src/shared/types.ts.summary: Single source of truth for every type in the system: FileCanopy, Todo, Comment, Feature, AuthorityHealth, RelationType, Closeness, IoMetadata, and the authority-vs-quality health check algorithm. All CLI tools, routes, and frontend components import from here. On-disk format is snake_case; TypeScript is camelCase — the case-transform boundary is documented but lives in a sibling file.

todos.text: EXTENSION_KIND_MAP is incomplete — no .go, .rs, .c, .cpp, .java, .rb, .php, .swift, .kt extensions. Any non-JS/TS/Python repo will show all files as 'unknown' kind in stats output.

comments.text: checkAuthorityHealth only flags promotion-candidate if authorityLevel !== 'standard'. This means a standard-level file can never be flagged as overscored, which is probably correct but worth stating explicitly — standards are the ceiling.

src/shared/case-transform.ts.title: Snake/Case Metadata Boundary
src/shared/case-transform.ts.summary: Recursively converts committed snake_case metadata to runtime camelCase and back while preserving path-like map keys. This prevents filenames containing dots or slashes from being silently rewritten during persistence.

src/shared/lifecycle.ts.title: Lifecycle Mark Validator And Interpreter
src/shared/lifecycle.ts.summary: Validates untrusted lifecycle metadata without discarding malformed evidence, derives open, due, expired, and resolved states from an explicit date, and keeps event- or release-bound marks open until external resolution is recorded.

src/shared/catalogue-search.ts.title: Bounded Authored Catalogue Search
src/shared/catalogue-search.ts.summary: Builds a local weighted index over authored paths, titles, summaries, tags, feature context, open TODOs, active lifecycle reasons, and findings. Returns bounded matches with visible evidence while excluding source text and relationship paths.

src/shared/catalogue-search.test.ts.summary: Protects searchable-field inclusion and exclusion, title-over-comment ranking, conservative prefix and typo matching, visible match evidence, lifecycle-date handling, and the hard result ceiling for authored catalogue search.

src/cli/__tests__/query-cli.test.ts.summary: Protects strict query option parsing: unknown flags fail with a clear error, nonzero status, and no misleading all-files output.

src/backend/lib/canopy.ts.title: Canopy Read/Write & Archive Engine
src/backend/lib/canopy.ts.summary: All disk I/O for canopy.json, settings.json, and canopy_archive.json. Handles snake↔camel case transformation at the read/write boundary, auto-generates RT-NNN and RC-NNN IDs, and runs archive sweeps that move completed TODOs to the archive after the retention window. Every route that mutates annotation data calls through here.

todos.text: writeCanopy uses fs.writeFileSync with no error handling or atomic write (write to temp + rename). A crash mid-write could corrupt canopy.json.
runArchiveSweep iterates all files on every TODO mutation. Fine for small repos but O(files × todos) on each write. Consider lazy sweep (sweep on read, or on interval).

src/backend/lib/agent-manifest.ts.title: Agent Review Manifest And Undo Engine
src/backend/lib/agent-manifest.ts.summary: Persists the non-canonical agent review feed, normalizes legacy statuses, assigns manifest IDs, and applies agree, fix, or reject decisions. Rejection can restore prior metadata through recorded undo snapshots; suggestions remain unapplied.

src/backend/lib/merge.ts.title: Authored And Generated Metadata Projection
src/backend/lib/merge.ts.summary: Builds the UI read model by merging optional repo-index enrichment with authored Canopy metadata, with authored values winning shared fields. It also normalizes relations and derives open-TODO pressure and authority-health signals.

src/backend/lib/profile.ts.title: Local Human Attribution Profile
src/backend/lib/profile.ts.summary: Resolves human attribution from explicit environment values, Git configuration, or OS identity, sanitizes it, and stores the profile in ignored profile.local.json. The profile stays local, while its chosen author signature is deliberately copied into shared review and edit attribution.

src/cli/stats.ts.title: canopytag stats — Orient Before You Dive
src/cli/stats.ts.summary: The first CLI call an agent should make. Reads canopy.json and prints file counts by kind (CODE/DOCS/TEST/CONFIG), authority distribution within each kind, open TODO count, and a next-step hint. Scoped by --feature or --tag. Output is compact enough for a prompt window. Detects file kind from extension + path conventions (test_ prefix, /test/ directory).

src/cli/ls.ts.title: canopytag ls — Top N Files by Authority
src/cli/ls.ts.summary: Lightweight summary table: FILE | AUTH | STATUS | FEATURE | TODOS | SUMMARY. Sorts by authority descending, then open TODO count. Default shows top 3 (--limit N or --all). Filtered by --feature or --tag. The step between `stats` (what exists) and `query` (deep dive).

src/cli/query.ts.title: canopytag query — Catalogue Search And Bounded Traversal
src/cli/query.ts.summary: Primary catalogue router combining bounded authored-field search with structured feature, tag, kind, trust, date, and relation filters. Direct results expose match evidence; detail levels then expand the authored relationship graph within explicit hop and closeness bounds.

todos.text: Connection walk is single-hop only — follows relatedFiles from direct matches but doesn't transitively follow connections-of-connections. For feature graphs deeper than 2 levels, agents miss files that are reachable but not directly linked from the top-authority file.

comments.text: Stability scored 3 because the depth model (numeric 1-5 with named aliases) and self-documenting footer are design bets that haven't been validated with real agent usage yet. The interface works but may evolve after dogfooding.

src/cli/__tests__/query.test.ts.title: Progressive Search And Relation Bounds
src/cli/__tests__/query.test.ts.summary: Protects query presentation, authored-field search integration, filter composition, result limits, and progressive relationship expansion whose hop and relation filters constrain graph noise. Search ranking details are tested in the shared catalogue-search suite.

src/cli/health.ts.title: canopytag health — Authority vs Quality Mismatch Detector
src/cli/health.ts.summary: Surfaces files where declared authority doesn't match quality scores. !! = underscored (spec with low quality — red flag). ^^ = promotion candidate (idea scoring like a guideline). ?? = unscored (has authority but no scores). Uses checkAuthorityHealth() from types.ts. Compact output — 105 lines total.

src/cli/todos.ts.title: canopytag todos — Flat TODO Query
src/cli/todos.ts.summary: Flat view of all TODOs across the repo, sorted by priority. Filters by --tag (matches TODO tags or file tags), --feature, --priority (max). The missing piece in the agent workflow: stats tells you how many TODOs exist, ls shows per-file counts, query shows TODOs scoped to a feature — but todos gives you the global prioritized list without needing to know which feature to ask about first.

src/backend/routes/config.ts.title: Active Repository Switch And Browse API
src/backend/routes/config.ts.summary: Switches the server's active repository, creates its Canopy directory, loads metadata, local identity, optional legacy index and tags, runs archive cleanup, then replaces shared server state. Its folder browser exposes host directory structure to the unauthenticated local API.

src/backend/routes/index.ts.title: Merged Repository Index API
src/backend/routes/index.ts.summary: Returns one record for the union of generated repo-index paths and authored Canopy paths. Each record uses authored-over-generated precedence and derived TODO and authority-health signals from the merge projection.

src/backend/routes/manifest.ts.title: Agent Activity Review API
src/backend/routes/manifest.ts.summary: Lists the agent manifest through manifest and activity aliases, then applies agree, fix, or reject decisions using the local human profile for attribution. Reject can invoke recorded undo behavior on already-applied changes.

src/backend/routes/rescan.ts.title: Legacy Repo-Index Reload API
src/backend/routes/rescan.ts.summary: Reloads only the optional docs/_meta/repo_index.json compatibility index into server state. It does not rescan source files, reload Canopy metadata, refresh tags, or rebuild structural maps despite returning a generic rescan-complete message.

src/backend/routes/file.ts.title: File Metadata API
src/backend/routes/file.ts.summary: Primary per-file read and write API. Reads merge authored metadata with optional generated index and Git date; writes update selected annotation fields and stamp the current local human as reviewer, but authority and status values currently lack runtime enum validation.

comments.text: POST /api/file/meta accepts any string for authorityLevel and status with a bare cast to FileCanopy types. Invalid values (e.g. authorityLevel: 'potato') will be saved to canopy.json and silently break health checks and query sorting.

src/backend/routes/todo.ts.title: TODO CRUD API
src/backend/routes/todo.ts.summary: POST /api/todo creates (text+priority required) or updates (by id) TODOs. Auto-generates RT-NNN IDs, timestamps createdAt, stamps completedAt when status→done. DELETE by path+todoId. Runs archive sweep after every write. Both create and update paths initialize the file entry and todos array if missing.

src/backend/routes/comment.ts.title: Comment CRUD API
src/backend/routes/comment.ts.summary: POST /api/comment creates comments with auto-generated RC-NNN IDs, optional type (finding/bug/improvement/note), and optional confidence (1-5). DELETE by path+commentId. Runs archive sweep after every write. Structurally parallel to todo.ts but simpler — comments are append-only (no update path).

src/backend/routes/tree.ts.title: File Tree API
src/backend/routes/tree.ts.summary: Read-only recursive filesystem tree for explorer navigation, delegated to the ignore-aware tree walker. It includes unannotated files and is therefore broader than the merged metadata index used by tables and the authored graph.

src/backend/routes/directory.ts.title: Directory Summary API
src/backend/routes/directory.ts.summary: Reads and edits human-authored directory shelf summaries while deriving file and open-TODO counts from annotated descendant paths. Counts therefore describe the current CanopyTag catalogue, not every file discovered by the filesystem tree.

src/backend/routes/features.ts.title: Feature CRUD API
src/backend/routes/features.ts.summary: Reads, upserts, and deletes feature cards. POST keeps basic-card replacement semantics while preserving omitted canonical file, owner, open-question, and promotion fields from richer existing cards; explicit camelCase values persist through the snake_case write boundary.

src/frontend/components/GraphView.tsx.title: Authored Semantic Relationship Graph
src/frontend/components/GraphView.tsx.summary: Human visualization of authored CanopyTag feature clusters and related_files, with overview and focus modes, filtering, authority or activity coloring, and weighted layout. It does not derive import, call, or symbol topology; generated structure belongs to Cartographer.

src/frontend/components/TableView.tsx.title: Files, Scores, TODOs, And Activity Review Tables
src/frontend/components/TableView.tsx.summary: Large multi-mode review surface for file inventory, quality scores, globally filterable TODOs, and attributed agent activity. It owns attention filters and agree, fix, or reject workflows, making it a human governance surface rather than a simple alternate list.

src/frontend/components/FileTree.tsx.title: Explorer File Tree And Activity Heat
src/frontend/components/FileTree.tsx.summary: Explorer navigation over discovered files and directories, enriched with TODO badges and optional seven-day activity heat. Search here filters the visible tree by path or name; it is not semantic or fuzzy catalogue retrieval.

src/frontend/components/Settings.tsx.title: Local Identity And Settings Panel
src/frontend/components/Settings.tsx.summary: Combines browser-local display preferences with repository-local archive and analytics settings plus an ignored local author profile. The profile file remains local, while its chosen author signature is intentionally recorded on shared edits and reviews.

src/frontend/components/WelcomeScreen.ts.title: Repository Picker And Demo Entry
src/frontend/components/WelcomeScreen.ts.summary: Repository connection and bundled-demo entry surface. It can browse local directories and instruct the backend to switch repository roots, so its convenience depends on the unauthenticated backend remaining loopback-only unless explicitly exposed.

src/frontend/lib/api.ts.title: Frontend Local API Facade
src/frontend/lib/api.ts.summary: Typed frontend facade over the local Fastify API for repository switching, merged records, annotations, TODOs, comments, features, settings, analytics, profiles, and activity review. It centralizes transport but performs little runtime response validation.

src/frontend/lib/authority.ts.title: Authority Display Vocabulary
src/frontend/lib/authority.ts.summary: Canonical UI copy and display mapping for the five-level authority hierarchy. It keeps compact labels and explanatory text consistent across score and table views; authority means conflict precedence, not a substitute for quality or freshness.

src/frontend/App.tsx.title: Root Layout & View Router
src/frontend/App.tsx.summary: Top-level connected-state and view router. It gates the repository picker, then coordinates explorer, table, authored graph, analytics, settings, demo guidance, save or error notices, and the agent-note banner.

src/frontend/components/FileDetail.tsx.title: File Annotation Editor
src/frontend/components/FileDetail.tsx.summary: Primary per-file human editor for title, summary, tags, I/O notes, authored relationships, trust scores, TODOs, and comments. Mutations round-trip through the local API and refresh the merged record; it does not display or edit source code.

todos.text: No optimistic UI — every edit round-trips to the server and refreshes the full file record. Feels fine locally but would lag on remote backends.

src/frontend/components/ScoreDisplay.tsx.title: Quality Scores & Authority Level UI
src/frontend/components/ScoreDisplay.tsx.summary: Human editor for four quality dimensions, authority, reviewed state, and review-versus-Git dates. It uses local profile attribution stamped by the file route; marking scores reviewed is a deliberate trust action, not proof of runtime validity.

src/frontend/stores/workspace.ts.title: Global UI State (Zustand)
src/frontend/stores/workspace.ts.summary: Single Zustand coordination store for repository connection, tree and index, selection, features and tags, agent notes, analytics, profile, view mode, and save or error state. Initial load treats analytics as optional; file edits refresh the selected record and merged index.

comments.text: State shape is growing — 14 state fields plus 10 actions in a single store. Not a problem yet, but if features (like multi-tab or undo) get added, consider splitting into slices.

AGENTS.md.title: Contributor Operating Guide
AGENTS.md.summary: Stable operating contract for contributors: architecture, product boundaries, shared-versus-local data rules, agent workflow, trust semantics, and validation. Read it before changing CanopyTag or its dogfood metadata; fast-changing feature details belong in nearby docs.

README.md.title: Public-Facing Project Overview
README.md.summary: Public entry point for installation and the local CLI/MCP workflow. It presents bounded authored catalogue discovery and post-rg enrichment as complementary, keeps source as truth, and documents shared-versus-local data plus the loopback default for the unauthenticated backend.

todos.text: README previously referenced legacy/internal metadata paths; public guidance now points to canopytag/canopy.json.
No mention of CLI tools (stats, ls, query, health) in README. These are the primary agent interface and should be prominently documented.

docs/cli-cheatsheet.md.title: CLI Cheatsheet
docs/cli-cheatsheet.md.summary: Compact agent sequence: use query --search for authored catalogue discovery, confirm source with rg, enrich paths with context, compare trust, traverse authored relations, then review TODO, health, or analytics signals.

docs/repo-local-data.md.title: Repo-Local Data And Public Repo Hygiene
docs/repo-local-data.md.summary: Canonical boundary between reviewable shared metadata and local-only identity, analytics, MCP, and hook configuration. It also defines portable repo-root resolution and the UTF-8 write versus BOM-tolerant read contract for CanopyTag JSON.

docs/roadmap.md.title: Public Roadmap
docs/roadmap.md.summary: Curated public roadmap replacing the old root TODO log. Captures current prerelease status, release blockers, near-term product work, agent navigation ideas, analytics and benchmarking plans, multi-repo ideas, structural-data/cartography philosophy, and design principles to preserve.

docs/design/document-lifecycle-marks.md.title: Document Lifecycle Marks Proposal
docs/design/document-lifecycle-marks.md.summary: Design and staged implementation for lifecycle trust modifiers on file records. Preservation, strict validation, date-derived warnings, and context, compare, and health rendering work now; filters, reviewed writes, promotion, and UI editing remain proposed.

docs/design/canopy-cartographer-integrat.title: CanopyCartographer Integration Proposal
docs/design/canopy-cartographer-integrat.summary: Proposes a provenance-rich sidecar boundary: CanopyTag owns authored meaning and current lexical catalogue search; Cartographer may add generated structure and optional local semantic recall only with evidence, freshness signals, staged promotion, and benchmarked benefit.

docs/canopytag-vs-ripgrep.md.title: Positioning: When Metadata Beats Text Search
docs/canopytag-vs-ripgrep.md.summary: Explains complementary retrieval: bounded authored catalogue discovery helps when names are uncertain, while rg confirms symbols, text, and source truth. CanopyTag adds trust, TODO, and semantic context only where maintained annotations repay their cost.

docs/architecture-md-and-codeowners.md.title: Where CanopyTag Fits in the Metadata Ecosystem
docs/architecture-md-and-codeowners.md.summary: Positions CanopyTag beside ARCHITECTURE.md, AGENTS.md, ADRs, CODEOWNERS, and external wikis rather than as their replacement. The ecosystem comparison remains useful, but at least one illustrative command no longer matches the implemented CLI.

docs/design/agent-analytics.md.title: Agent Analytics Design And Privacy Contract
docs/design/agent-analytics.md.summary: Approved design and privacy contract for local agent-activity heat across the hook, analytics store, CLI, MCP increments, and UI. It is partly stale: the document says analytics are not API-exposed, while a read route now serves local analytics to the loopback UI.

docs/surprise-and-traversal.md.title: Surprise-Based Navigation And Feature Traversal
docs/surprise-and-traversal.md.summary: Design note for routing across feature boundaries and recording expectation violations that filenames cannot convey. It prioritizes lightweight gotchas and drift signals, explicitly rejects a probabilistic surprise engine, and leaves several traversal questions open.

src/cli/mcp.ts.title: Project-Local MCP Configuration Scaffolder
src/cli/mcp.ts.summary: Merges a CanopyTag server entry into an existing .mcp.json while preserving unrelated servers, refuses to replace a differing CanopyTag entry without force, and supports a print-only preview. Generated configuration contains local absolute paths.

src/cli/tags.ts.title: Tag Vocabulary CLI
src/cli/tags.ts.summary: Exposes live in-use tag counts, substring filtering, and soft declared-vocabulary health checks through the shared tag hygiene engine. Its search filters tags already present on cards; it is not fuzzy catalogue retrieval.

src/cli/shared.ts.title: CLI Shared Utilities — The Foundation Layer
src/cli/shared.ts.summary: Every CLI tool and MCP read tool imports from here. Provides resolveRepoRoot/resolveCanopyPath (canonical canopytag/canopy.json path), fileKind (extension+path→module/doc/test/config/asset/data), AUTHORITY_RANK for sorting, aggregateScore/warningCount for health checks, and the full filter+sort pipeline (FileFilters, parseBaseFilters, filterFiles, sortFiles). Defines 9 sort keys including 'attention' (composite: warnings + unreviewed + TODOs weighted by authority). Also handles git date integration for --git-after/--git-before filters.

src/cli/context.ts.title: canopytag context — Compact Agent Prompt Injection
src/cli/context.ts.summary: Renders compact context blocks for files or features, designed for injecting into agent prompts. Three modes: single file, multi-file (after grep), and feature (aggregated). Per-file output shows summary, dimension warnings (scores below authority-level minimums), finding comments, open TODOs, relations (filtered by closeness >= depth), and tags. Feature mode aggregates dimension averages, flags weakest dimension, collects all TODOs. The bridge between annotation data and agent context windows.

src/cli/compare.ts.title: canopytag compare - File Trust Comparator
src/cli/compare.ts.summary: Compares exact files by authority rank, quality composite, freshness, warning count, TODO pressure, per-dimension scores, summaries, and trust order. This is the agent-facing tool for deciding which document or source file should win when multiple search hits conflict. Reuses shared authorityScore, aggregateScore, warningCount, and freshness helpers, and tracks explicit compared files as canopy queries.

src/cli/coverage.ts.title: canopytag coverage — Annotation Coverage & Orphan Detection
src/cli/coverage.ts.summary: Reports what percentage of repo files are annotated, groups unannotated files by kind, and detects orphaned canopy entries (annotated files that no longer exist on disk). Two core functions: discoverRepoFiles (git ls-files + .ctagignore filtering, excludes canopy dir) and buildCoverage (pure set-diff computation). Optional --detail shows per-file field completeness sorted by least complete first. Only kind filter applies to coverage — tag/feature filters can't work on unannotated files since they have no canopy entry. Also registered as canopytag_coverage MCP tool.

src/cli/graph.ts.title: Relation Graph Walker — Fan-in/Fan-out Engine
src/cli/graph.ts.summary: BFS graph traversal over relatedFiles edges. Builds a reverse index (who points at this file?) for fan-in, walks forward edges for fan-out. Returns a GraphNode tree with hop count, relation type, and closeness at each node. Configurable: hops (max depth), minCloseness (edge filter), relation (type filter). Renders as indented text with directional arrows (← fan-in, → fan-out). Used by canopytag_fan_in and canopytag_fan_out MCP tools. Pure computation — no I/O.

src/cli/init.ts.title: canopytag init — Repo Bootstrap
src/cli/init.ts.summary: Creates canopytag/ directory with empty canopy.json and default settings.json. Safe to run on already-initialized repos — detects existing canopytag/canopy.json and prints status without overwriting. Prints next-step guidance pointing to stats, ls, and MCP tools. Simple script — no guard needed since it's only invoked directly.

src/mcp/server.ts.title: MCP Server Entry Point
src/mcp/server.ts.summary: 17-line entry point — creates McpServer, registers read and write tools via separate modules, connects over stdio transport. Agents invoke this via Claude Code's MCP config. No business logic here; all tool implementations are in reads.ts and writes-registration.ts.

src/mcp/tools/agent-manifest.ts.title: Agent Manifest Review Report
src/mcp/tools/agent-manifest.ts.summary: Renders pending or historical agent-review entries with proposed fields, staged-versus-applied state, freshness suggestions, TODOs, rationale, and outcomes. File and status filters are exact, and output ordering is deterministic by date then ID.

src/mcp/tools/reads.ts.title: MCP Read Tools — Agent Query Interface
src/mcp/tools/reads.ts.summary: Registers 10 read-only MCP tools: stats, ls, query, context, todos, health, tags, fan_in, fan_out, coverage. Each tool resolves paths, reads canopy, calls the corresponding build*() function from CLI modules, and returns text content. Uses Zod schemas for parameter validation. Shared filterParams object provides consistent filter options across tools. Also wires analytics tracking — canopytag_query and canopytag_context record which files agents access via incrementFile().

comments.text: MCP read tools now include canopytag_compare for exact-file authority and quality comparison. It wraps src/cli/compare.ts and tracks matched files as canopy queries.

src/mcp/tools/writes.ts.title: MCP Write Handlers — Mutation Logic
src/mcp/tools/writes.ts.summary: MCP mutation handlers for canopy writes and sidecar suggestions. handleAddComment is always allowed, handleAnnotate and handleAddTodo respect locked files, handleRenameTag bulk-renames tags, and handleStageSuggestion writes non-canonical review-feed entries. All applied writes append agent_manifest.json activity with undo metadata. Agent attribution is dynamic via tool parameters or CANOPYTAG_AGENT_NAME / CANOPYTAG_AGENT_SESSION. Tag writes include fuzzy duplicate detection.

todos.text: AGENT_AUTHOR is hardcoded to { role: 'agent', name: 'claude' }. Should be dynamic to support non-Claude agents writing annotations.

src/mcp/tools/writes-registration.ts.title: MCP Write Tools — Zod Registration Layer
src/mcp/tools/writes-registration.ts.summary: Registers 4 MCP write tools (add_comment, annotate, add_todo, rename_tag) with Zod parameter schemas. Thin wiring layer — each tool calls the corresponding handler from writes.ts with try/catch for error responses. Separated from writes.ts so handler logic is independently testable without MCP SDK dependencies.

src/mcp/tools/tags.ts.title: Tag Vocabulary Engine
src/mcp/tools/tags.ts.summary: Collects live tag vocabulary from canopy.json with usage counts. Supports search (substring match, alphabetical) and browse (top N by count). Includes fuzzy duplicate detection: Levenshtein distance <=2 and separator normalization (dash/underscore). buildTags() renders the full output with duplicate warnings. Used by canopytag_tags tool and by writes.ts to warn when new tags are near-duplicates of existing vocabulary.

src/backend/server.ts.title: Fastify Web Server — Bootstrap & Route Registration
src/backend/server.ts.summary: Web UI backend bootstrap: selects the repository, loads CanopyTag metadata, registers API routes, and runs the archive sweep. It binds to loopback by default; non-loopback exposure must be explicit and is unauthenticated.

src/backend/lib/network.ts.title: Backend Network Exposure Boundary
src/backend/lib/network.ts.summary: Resolves the backend bind host with a loopback-only default and emits a prominent warning for explicit non-loopback exposure. This is the safety boundary around CanopyTag's unauthenticated local repository API.

src/backend/__tests__/network.test.ts.title: Backend Network Boundary Tests
src/backend/__tests__/network.test.ts.summary: Verifies loopback-by-default host resolution, explicit override precedence, loopback recognition, and warnings for exposing the unauthenticated API.

src/backend/lib/analytics.ts.title: Agent Activity Analytics Engine
src/backend/lib/analytics.ts.summary: Tracks local per-file read, edit, write, and catalogue-query counts with daily bucketing in ignored .analytics.json. It supplies windowed heat and totals for CLI and UI views; behavioral frequency is a maintenance signal, not semantic authority.

src/backend/lib/git-info.ts.title: Git Date Lookup
src/backend/lib/git-info.ts.summary: Two functions: getLastModified (git log -1 for a single file) and getLastModifiedBatch (iterates getLastModified for multiple files). Returns ISO date strings. Used by shared.ts for --git-after/--git-before filters and --modified sort key. Currently O(n) shell calls for batch — TODO notes optimization with git log --name-only.

src/backend/lib/tree-walker.ts.title: File System Tree Walker
src/backend/lib/tree-walker.ts.summary: Recursive directory walker that builds TreeNode structures for the sidebar file tree. Filters with ALWAYS_SKIP set (30+ entries: .git, node_modules, dist, IDE dirs, lock files, etc.), .gitignore patterns, and .ctagignore patterns. Folders sorted before files, then alphabetical. Used by the /api/tree endpoint. Separate from coverage's discoverRepoFiles which uses git ls-files instead of fs.readdir.

src/cli.summary: Serverless agent commands for orientation, filtering, context, comparison, TODOs, health, coverage, graph walks, analytics, and integration setup. Most read commands share filtering and sorting primitives, and several builders are reused by MCP.

src/mcp.summary: Stdio MCP adapter for compatible agents. Read tools reuse CLI builders; write tools record attribution and undo data, support staged suggestions, and expose tag and activity-review context without requiring the web server.

src/backend/lib.summary: Backend helpers for canopy persistence, agent manifests, local profiles, analytics, Git dates, merged records, filesystem trees, and network exposure. They support routes and CLI or MCP operations without owning UI policy.

src/backend/routes.summary: Fastify API surface for repository selection, tree and merged index reads, annotation mutations, settings, analytics, profiles, archives, and activity review. Routes share mutable per-repository state initialized by the server bootstrap.

src/frontend/components.summary: Human catalogue interface spanning explorer editing, sortable file and review tables, authored relationship graphs, local analytics, repo selection, settings, and agent-activity review. Large view components coordinate through the shared workspace store.

docs.summary: Public usage, positioning, operating boundaries, roadmap, and bounded design rationale. Stable guidance and exploratory blueprints coexist here, so authority, status, freshness, and lifecycle warnings must remain visible during retrieval.

src/shared.summary: Cross-surface contracts and deterministic transformations for schema, case conversion, lifecycle interpretation, and bounded authored catalogue search. These modules define behavior reused by CLI, MCP, backend, and UI without owning source topology.

annotation-engine.name: Annotation Engine
annotation-engine.description: Authored metadata model and persistence boundary for summaries, trust, lifecycle, relationships, TODOs, comments, features, archives, and merged reads. Generated cartography should remain in provenance-rich sidecars rather than silently becoming canonical metadata.

cli-tools.name: Agent-Facing CLI
cli-tools.description: Local command surface for orientation, bounded authored catalogue search, comparison, health, TODOs, coverage, analytics, MCP setup, and hooks. Commands verify repo-local metadata without requiring the web server, and MCP reuses several builders.

web-ui.name: Web UI
web-ui.description: React and Fastify interface for browsing and editing annotations, tables, authored graphs, local analytics, activity review, profiles, and repository selection. Its unauthenticated local-repository backend must remain loopback-only unless exposure is explicit.

mcp-server.name: MCP Server
mcp-server.description: Local stdio adapter exposing catalogue reads, semantic relationship traversal, attributed mutations, staged suggestions, and activity-review inspection to compatible agents. It reuses CLI builders where practical instead of becoming a second intelligence store.

docs.name: Documentation And Positioning
docs.description: Public usage, contributor contracts, product positioning, lifecycle designs, and roadmap. README serves users, AGENTS governs contributors, and blueprint or draft design notes must not silently outrank current implementation.

lifecycle-trust.name: Lifecycle And Trust Signals
lifecycle-trust.description: Optional trust modifiers for temporary, provisional, superseded, condensation, and review-needed context. Read paths preserve and warn on authored marks without replacing authority, freshness, quality scores, or explicit human resolution.
open_questions: What reviewed write and promotion workflow should lifecycle marks use?
When should lifecycle filters and UI editing become default surfaces?

agent-analytics.name: Local Agent Analytics
agent-analytics.description: Optional local activity heat from client hooks and CanopyTag queries. It helps humans inspect navigation patterns without uploading source or storing query strings; behavioral frequency is not treated as semantic authority.
open_questions: Which analytics signals materially improve maintenance or retrieval decisions?
How should additional agent clients integrate without weakening privacy boundaries?

activity-review.name: Agent Activity Review
activity-review.description: Attributed review feed for direct agent writes and non-canonical suggestions. Humans can agree, fix, or reject entries with undo context, separating immediately useful agent work from later confidence and governance decisions.
open_questions: How should high-volume review remain fast without auto-promoting uncertain semantic changes?
